_comment: Characters lost to a bad decode before the data reached us: each U+FFFD stands where one Arabic character should be. check_content.py and Tools/Hadith/hadith_gate.py treat this inventory as a ceiling: a U+FFFD in a hadith text that is not listed here, or more of them than recorded, fails the content build. It is empty. The 154 U+FFFD recorded on 2026-08-08 in 76 narrations (Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Ibn Majah, Malik), which both Arabic editions of fawazahmed0/hadith-api carry, were repaired on 2026-10-29 from the same narration's Arabic on sunnah.com, and no hadith seed holds a U+FFFD any more.
_resolution: Repaired by the October 2026 audit (track hadith-data): a run of U+FFFD was replaced only where its exact 4-10 character context occurs once in the same narration's sunnah.com Arabic and the replacement has as many UTF-8 bytes as there were U+FFFD. List a narration here only for a defect that no available source can repair, never to let a new one through.
